evaluation_scope.geographic_domain: Western Ghats & Maharashtra Corridor (240 pts @ 0.5°) + Core Monsoon Zone Sample (84 pts @ 1.0°)

observation_contract.provider: India Meteorological Department (IMD), National Climate Centre, Pune
observation_contract.product_name: IMD 0.25° x 0.25° High Resolution Daily Gridded Rainfall Analysis
observation_contract.format: Binary IEEE 32-bit float grid (135 lons x 129 lats) / NetCDF4 archive (RF25_ind2024_rfp25.nc)
observation_contract.land_sea_mask: IMD operational national land boundary mask

forecast_contract.archive_product_type: Fixed-offset Previous Runs rolling archive (precipitation, precipitation_previous_day1..3)
forecast_contract.archive_metadata_notice: Open-Meteo documentation identifies historical 2024 ECMWF IFS runs as IFS Cycle 49R1 hindcasts/re-forecast archive rather than certified as-issued operational broadcast feeds.
forecast_contract.initialization_time_semantics: Stitched rolling lead-offset archive. Individual initialization run cycles (00Z vs 12Z) are not uniquely isolated in hourly series.
forecast_contract.availability_assumptions: Forecast decision time is assumed to be 05:30 IST (00:00 UTC) on Day D. Under operational conditions, ECMWF IFS 00Z runs require 4-6 hours distribution latency, meaning Day D 05:30 IST decisions operationally rely on the D-1 12Z cycle.
forecast_contract.operational_timeline_caveat: The IMD 24h accumulation interval spans 08:30 IST on Day D-1 to 08:30 IST on Day D. If an operational pipeline executes at 05:30 IST on Day D, 21 hours of that 24h target interval have already elapsed in chronological time. Therefore, this benchmark evaluates post-processing of fixed-offset 24h accumulations (retrieved from the Open-Meteo Previous Runs day-1 archive), and must NOT be described as a prospective day-ahead forecast issued prior to the start of the accumulation interval.
forecast_contract.hourly_timestamp_semantics: Open-Meteo hourly timestamp T represents the precipitation accumulated over the PRECEDING hour (T-1 to T].
forecast_contract.accumulation_summation_rule: 24 hours ending 03:00 UTC Day D is formed by summing hourly timestamps (D-1)T04:00 through (D)T03:00 (20 hours from D-1 plus 4 hours from D).
forecast_contract.aggregation_classification: Multi-run stitched lead-offset aggregate; must NOT be presented as a certified single-run isolated forecast cycle.

lead_claim_status.day_1_lead: Verified Previous Day 1 offset harvest against IMD 08:30 IST window
lead_claim_status.day_2_lead: Provisional Previous Day 2 offset harvest; lead-specific causality gated pending cycle run tracking
lead_claim_status.day_3_lead: Provisional Previous Day 3 offset harvest; lead-specific causality gated pending cycle run tracking
